title: Construction Accounting
description:
We’re hiring a Project Accountant to support construction, loan, and compliance operations across multiple affordable housing developments. If you’re detail-driven, good with documentation, and like work that has real impact, this is a strong long-term fit.



Why You’ll Love This Role



You will work directly with decision-makers — your work will be visible and valued.

You will help keep projects compliant, funded, and on schedule.

No bureaucracy, no busywork — your work directly moves projects forward.

Real room to grow into senior financial coordination or project support.



Your Typical Day

Organize and maintain project financial and compliance documentation.

Support the preparation of monthly construction draw requests.

Communicate with contractors to collect invoices, lien waivers, and documents.

Update budgets, change order logs, and payment tracking sheets.

Coordinate with lenders, accounting, and project managers as needed.



What You’ll Be Doing



1) Loan & Draw Support

Compile lien waivers, invoices, schedules, and supporting docs for draw packages.

Compare cost reports to contracts, change orders, and lender requirements.

Track soft costs (architect, engineering, inspections, interest, title, etc.).

Prepare clear, organized submission files for lenders.



2) Construction Financial Administration

Maintain digital project files (contracts, pay apps, insurance, permits, payrolls).

Track executed change orders against pay apps and budgets.

Monitor buyout logs, completion schedules, and compliance documents.

Follow up with contractors until documentation is accurate and complete.



3) General Coordination & Reporting

Maintain trackers, logs, and internal reports.

Prepare agendas, notes, and status reports for project meetings.

Communicate professionally with internal and external stakeholders.

Handle confidential financial data with discretion.



What We’re Looking For

2–4+ years in project accounting, construction admin, or loan/draw processing.

Familiarity with construction draws, budgets, or lender compliance preferred.

Proficiency in Excel and document management tools (Procore/Built/Buildertrend a bonus).

Extremely organized, detail-accurate, and accountable to deadlines.

Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Experience working for a US construction company or real-estate developer



Nice to Have

title: QA Automation Engineer (Cypress or Similar)
description:
Job Title: QA Automation Engineer (Remote – Philippines)

Location: Remote – Philippines

Company: EETech



About EETech



EETech is a dynamic technology company committed to delivering innovative digital commerce solutions. Our global team collaborates to create cutting-edge platforms that drive success for our clients. We value creativity, technical excellence, and a forward-thinking approach to solving complex challenges.





Job Overview

EETech is looking for a skilled QA Automation Engineer to ensure our software products are robust, efficient, and ready for production. In this remote role, you will design and develop automated test scripts, integrate testing frameworks into our CI/CD pipelines, and work collaboratively with cross-functional teams to improve product quality. This position is ideal for a proactive engineer who is passionate about leveraging automation to drive continuous improvement in quality assurance.





Key Responsibilities

• Test Automation Development:

o Design, develop, and maintain automated test scripts for web and mobile applications.

o Implement automated testing frameworks and integrate them with existing CI/CD pipelines.



• Quality Assurance & Continuous Improvement:

o Collaborate with development and product teams to identify test requirements and ensure comprehensive test

coverage.

o Analyze test results, track issues, and work with the team to resolve defects promptly.



• Framework & Tool Enhancement:

o Evaluate and implement new automation tools and best practices to enhance testing efficiency and accuracy.

o Maintain and update existing test suites in response to new feature developments or changes.



• Documentation & Reporting:

o Create detailed test plans, test cases, and technical documentation to support automation efforts.

o Provide clear, concise reports on test outcomes, quality metrics, and areas for improvement.



• Collaboration & Agile Practices:

o Actively participate in agile ceremonies, including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and retrospectives.

o Work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure timely delivery of high-quality software solutions.





Qualifications

• Technical Skills:

o Proficiency in programming languages such as JavaScript, Python, or Java.

o Strong experience with test automation frameworks (e.g., Selenium, Cypress, Appium).

o Familiarity with CI/CD tools and processes (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD).



• Experience:

o Proven track record in automating test cases for web and mobile applications.

o Experience in a remote work environment with effective communication and time management skills.



• Soft Skills:

o Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities with keen attention to detail.

o Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with diverse teams.



• Preferred Qualifications:

o Experience with performance and load testing tools is a plus.

o Knowledge of agile development methodologies and continuous testing practices.





What We Offer

• Remote Work Flexibility:

o Enjoy the freedom to work from anywhere in the Philippines while collaborating with a global team.

• Collaborative Environment:

o Be part of an innovative, team-oriented culture that values technical excellence and continuous improvement.

description:
Job Title: Experienced UK Property Sourcer /Sourcing 

Employment Type: Part-Time or Full-Time (to be discussed)



About the Role



We are seeking an experienced UK Property Sourcer with a minimum of 2 years’ proven experience sourcing property in the UK market — ideally with exposure to commercial and retail property. This is an opportunity to lead a new venture focused on sourcing retail and mixed-use assets, both on-market and off-market, across key UK cities.



The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of the UK property market, commercial property terminology, and deal structuring, with the ability to work independently to identify, qualify, and build a consistent pipeline of property opportunities aligned to our investment criteria.



Key Responsibilities



Conduct high-volume searches for suitable retail and commercial property opportunities across targeted UK regions.



Source both on-market and off-market opportunities through a combination of platforms, agent relationships, and direct outreach.



Develop and maintain relationships with commercial agents, property brokers, and landlords.



Create and manage a property pipeline of qualified leads that meet the company’s investment and acquisition criteria.



Present shortlisted and qualified opportunities to senior management once they reach agreed heads of terms or negotiation stages.



Monitor and report on market trends, pricing movements, and geographic variations across the UK.



Maintain accurate sourcing records, communications, and deal progress in CRM or other agreed formats.



Requirements



Minimum 2 years’ experience sourcing property in the UK market (commercial or residential).



Demonstrated experience and results in commercial property sourcing strongly preferred.



Familiarity with major UK property listing platforms (Rightmove Commercial, EG Propertylink, Realla, CoStar, Zoopla, etc.) and agent networks.



Strong understanding of UK geography, particularly key retail and commercial hubs.



Working knowledge of commercial property terms, deal structures, and acquisition processes.



Excellent communication and negotiation skills, both written and verbal.



Highly organised with the ability to manage multiple opportunities concurrently.



Proactive, self-driven, and target-oriented with a hunger to grow a sourcing division.



What We Offer



Opportunity to lead and grow a sourcing function from inception.



Competitive remuneration and performance-based incentives.



Long-term growth potential into a senior leadership role overseeing the sourcing division.



Supportive and entrepreneurial environment with direct access to senior decision-makers.



To Apply



Please submit your CV and a cover letter outlining:



Your relevant property sourcing experience, including specific UK commercial property examples.

Generic or AI-generated responses will be immediately rejected — we’re looking for genuine, experience-based applications only.

Was your sourcing experience primarily conducted online, by
, phone, letter, or other methods? Are you sourcing on-market or off-market opportunities?

What are your long-term career goals in property or investment?

• Ability to collaborate with cross-functional tea
mbers remotely.

• Familiarity with mineral rights, well structures, or technical records is a plus.

• Awareness of regulatory standards for documentation in the energy or mineral sectors is beneficial.





Competencies and Attributes:

• Aligns with the team’s emphasis on operational excellence, compliance, and support for technical evaluation.

• Open to collaboration, feedback, and process alignment across teams.





What’s in it for you:

title: Marketing & Creative Manager — Remote, Part-Time to Full-Time
description:
Who we are

We're a small, remote team running a personal care brand on 
 since 2021. We do solid revenue, we're profitable, and we've built something real. Now we're ready to grow beyond Amazon — and we need the right person to help make that happen. The founder works directly with the team. No layers, no politics. You'll know exactly where you stand and what matters.



What we need

We've built a strong Amazon foundation. The next step is Shopify, Meta ads, and influencers — and we need someone who can own all three.



Concretely, this means:

-Set up and manage our Shopify store

-Run Meta ads to drive traffic to both Shopify and Amazon

-Find and manage influencer partnerships and UGC creators

-Support creative production using AI image tools and basic design

-Help improve our Amazon listings — images, copy, A+ content



This is not a task-taker role. You'll own these areas. You d
 what needs to be done, you build the plan, you execute it.



Who this is for

You've done this before. You know Shopify, you've run Meta campaigns, you've worked with creators. You're comfortable using AI tools for content and image generation. You don't need hand-holding — you need a good brand, clear goals, and the freedom to run.

If you're looking for a boss who sends you daily to-do lists, this isn't the right fit. If you want to own something and grow with a brand long-term, read on.

To show you've read this carefully, include the word "ownership" somewhere in your application.



What we offer

This role starts part-time. That's intentional — we want to find the right person first, build trust, and grow together. The plan is to move to full-time in 2027 as the brand scales.



If you're looking for a quick gig, this isn't it. If you want to be part of building something from the ground up and grow with the team over the long term, this is the opportunity.



Fully remote, flexible hours. Direct access to the founder. Fixed base to start, with performance bonuses added as we grow.

This role requires experience designing for both web and mobile applications, an understanding of modern development workflows, and comfort using Figma, Codex, and AI-assisted product workflows to accelerate execution.

title: YA Book Editor / Story Development Assistant for Sci-Fi Series
description:
I am looking for a talented book editor and story development assistant based in the Philippines to help me finish and prepare a YA/adult crossover sci-fi series for self-publishing.



The first four books are already about 50–75% written. I need help moving them from draft form to finished manuscripts ready for publication. This may begin as part-time or project-based work, with the possibility of becoming full-time after the books move closer to press.



The series is about two twin worlds and the different choices each world makes. It is written for young readers and adult crossover readers, especially girls and young women around the world: White, Beige, Tan, Brown, and Black. The story is about survival, leadership, love, grief, courage, women, children, power, and hope.



This is not just proofreading. I need someone who can help with story, structure, clarity, and finishing.



Responsibilities may include:



Reading chapters and giving clear feedback



Helping organize scenes, chapters, and book structure



Pointing out where YA readers may get confused



Giving input on pacing, character, clarity, and emotional flow



Helping shape final chapters



Tracking continuity across the first four books



Helping prepare manuscripts for self-publishing



Researching translation options for at least six languages



Researching publishing, formatting, and international distribution outlets



Protecting the author’s voice while making the books stronger



The ideal candidate:



Has excellent English reading and editing skills



Has experience with fiction, YA, sci-fi, fantasy, dystopian, or long-form writing



Understands what keeps young readers interested



Can give honest but kind feedback



Can help with structure, not just grammar



Is organized, reliable, and comfortable with a large creative project



Has helped writers, authors, students, or creators finish written work



Can do online research for self-publishing, translation, and global book markets



A marketing expert may be hired later. For now, this role is focused on editing, structure, completion, self-publishing preparation, and translation research.



To apply, please send:



A short introduction



Your editing, writing, or publishing experience



Any books, manuscripts, blogs, or creative projects you have helped with



Your experience with YA, sci-fi, fantasy, or multicultural stories



Your hourly rate or project rate

We are looking for an experienced Salesforce expert to help us design and implement a complete CRM and operations system inside Salesforce. The goal is to build a clean, reliable system so our company can operate primarily inside Salesforce instead of using multiple disconnected tools.



This is an implementation and architecture role. We want someone who can plan the structure correctly and then build it.



Our focus is simplicity, reliability, and automation.



About Our Company



We are a growing home services company in the United States focused on storm shelters. Our business generates leads through phone calls and website inquiries and we need a streamlined system for managing leads, sales, estimates, and customer lifecycle.



Currently we use multiple tools, and we want to consolidate as much as possible into Salesforce.



Primary Goals



• Centralize lead management and customer data  

• Track phone and web leads inside Salesforce  

• Manage the full sales pipeline  

• Automate follow-ups and notifications  

• Create a simple quoting / estimate workflow  

• Track customer status from lead ? sale ? installation  

• Provide clear dashboards and reporting  



Responsibilities



• Design the Salesforce architecture for our business  

• Set up Sales Cloud (and other modules if needed)  

• Create pipelines, stages, and opportunity management  

• Build automations and workflows  

• Configure lead capture from forms and phone calls  

• Design quote/estimate workflow  

• Set up dashboards and reporting  

• Configure integrations with other systems if required  

• Document the system and train our team



Requirements



• Strong Salesforce implementation experience  

• Ability to architect systems, not just configure fields  

• Experience with workflow automation and process design  

• Experience integrating external tools and APIs  

• Ability to simplify systems (we prefer clean over complex)  

• Strong communication and documentation skills



Nice to Have



• Experience with home services or contractor businesses  

• Experience with call tracking integrations  

• Experience building quoting workflows in Salesforce  

• Salesforce certifications



Project Scope



Initial engagement will focus on system architecture and implementation. After the system is live, there may be ongoing work for improvements and optimization.



Important



We are looking for someone who can build a simple, reliable system rather than overengineering the platform. Our goal is for our team to operate inside Salesforce daily with minimal complexity.



If you apply, please include:



• Examples of Salesforce systems you have implemented

title: Inbound Sales & Dispatch Specialist
description:
Inbound Sales & Dispatch Specialist

Growth Pathway to Sales Manager / Team Leader



Company: Staff Connect (on behalf of our client)

Location: Remote – Philippines-based

Employment Type: Full-time (40 hours per week)

Compensation: Competitive base salary + performance incentives + sales bonuses, with high performers able to earn up to PHP 70,000 per month through bonus opportunities.

Schedule: Rotating 10-hour shifts across AEST business hours, with approximately 3–4 shifts rostered per week.

Leave: One week paid leave per year 



About the Client



Our client is Australia’s leading misfuelling specialist, providing nationwide roadside assistance to motorists who a
 put the wrong fuel in their vehicle.



Their team supports customers during stressful situations by delivering fast, professional, and empathetic service while coordinating technicians across Australia.



Staff Connect is partnering with the client to build and expand their offshore operations team in the Philippines, creating strong long-term career opportunities for high-performing individuals with leadership potential.



The Opportunity

Inbound Sales & Dispatch Specialist

Career Progression to Sales Manager / Team Leader



This is a fast-paced, sales-driven role focused on converting inbound enquiries into confirmed bookings while delivering exceptional customer support.



You will manage inbound roadside assistance calls, coordinate technicians nationwide, and ensure urgent jobs are handled efficiently from start to finish.



This role is best suited to candidates with previous roadside assistance, emergency dispatch, towing, transport coordination, or high-volume dispatching experience, as the environment requires strong multitasking skills, urgency, and confidence managing time-sensitive situations.



High-performing tea
mbers who consistently achieve strong sales results and operational excellence will have the opportunity to progress into leadership roles and eventually help manage the offshore team.



Performance Expectations



Successful candidates will be expected to:



- Achieve a minimum of 35 confirmed jobs sold per month

- Maintain strong inbound conversion rates

- Deliver exceptional customer service under pressure

- Efficiently coordinate and manage live dispatch operations

- Accurately handle bookings, job updates, and technician coordination

- Maximise every inbound sales opportunity



This role is ideal for individuals who are confident in sales, highly organised, calm under pressure, and experienced in fast-moving dispatch environments.



Key Responsibilities

Inbound Sales & Customer Service

- Handle inbound calls from customers requiring urgent roadside assistance

- Convert enquiries into confirmed bookings through confident communication and objection handling

- Deliver calm, empathetic, and professional customer support

- Collect deposits and accurately record booking information

- Meet and exceed monthly sales targets and KPIs



Dispatch & Operations Coordination

- Coordinate technicians across Australia using dispatch and booking platforms

- Monitor live jobs and technician availability in real time

- Manage cases from initial enquiry through to completion

- Communicate with customers and technicians via phone, Slack, Gmail, and SMS

- Prioritise urgent and high-pressure jobs efficiently



Quality Control & Administration

- Review jobs daily to ensure accurate completion and closure

- Identify missed opportunities, incomplete bookings, or operational issues

- Maintain accurate records in GeoOp and Xero

- Ensure ETAs, notes, discounts, and call outcomes are properly logged

- Support operational compliance and workflow accuracy



Process Improvement & Team Support

- Assist with updating templates, documents, and operational processes

- Participate in Slack huddles, training sessions, and coaching

- Support escalated customer concerns when required

- Contribute ideas to improve dispatch efficiency and customer experience

- Be comfortable participating in video meetings and team collaboration



What We’re Looking For

Essential Requirements

- Minimum 2 years’ experience in:

- Roadside assistance dispatch

- Emergency or high-volume dispatch environments

- Strong understanding of fast-paced roadside assistance workflows and urgent customer situations

- Experience coordinating mobile technicians and managing live jobs in real time

- Ability to confidently explain services and convert inbound enquiries into confirmed bookings

- Strong communication and objection-handling skills

- Excellent attention to detail when managing bookings, ETAs, and customer updates

- Calm, professional, and solutions-focused under pressure

- Comfortable supporting customers dealing with vehicle misfuelling i
, including fuel extraction, fuel replacement, and vehicle testing services

- Proficient in Google Workspace, Gmail, and web-based dispatch systems

- Comfortable using Slack and participating in online meetings and huddles

- Reliable work-from-home setup with stable internet connection



Highly Regarded

- Previous experience in:

- Misfuelling or fuel recovery services

- Automotive roadside assistance

- Mechanical or vehicle service coordination

- Knowledge of Australian roads and geography

- Experience working with Australian customers or operations

- Leadership, coaching, or tea
ntoring experience



What’s in It for You

- Fully remote work-from-home opportunity

- Competitive salary with performance-based incentives

- Clear progression pathway into leadership roles

- Ongoing training and development

- Opportunity to work with a growing international team

- Supportive and collaborative work culture

- Long-term career growth opportunities for high performers

title: Local Project Coordinator — Land Development (Laguna, Philippines)
description:
We are chasing our dream in Magdalena, Laguna — purchasing agricultural land in Brgy. San Isidro and developing it into a home and farm. Before we finalize the purchase, we need someone on the ground to gather key information and quotes from local offices and contractors.



What we need help with:

• Visit the Municipal Engineering Office of Magdalena to request referrals for local gravel road contractors

• Visit or call the barangay captain of Brgy. San Isidro to ask about water grid availability and connection cost

• Contact Meralco San Pablo regarding electricity connection requirements and cost estimate for our property

• Contact Laguna Water to confirm if the area falls within their service coverage

• Collect rough quotes from contractors for: gravel road construction (approximately 427m, 4.5m wide), deep well drilling, electricity connection, and water connection to the local grid network

• Compile all findings into a clear written summary report



Please note: we are in the process of commissioning a geodetic survey of the property, which will provide the accurate terrain and distance data contractors typically need for final quotes. For now, rough estimates based on the location and general scope are what we are after. Quotes can be refined later once survey data is available.



What we are looking for:

• Based in or near Magdalena, San Pablo, or Sta. Cruz, Laguna

• Fluent in Tagalog and English

• Someone who follows through — you do what you say you will do

• A fast mover when it comes to gathering information — you know how to get answers quickly

• Creative with problem solving — if one door is closed you find another way

• Able to deliver a clear written summary of findings, not just a verbal update

• Experience in construction, land, or property coordination is a plus but not required



Compensation:

Base rate is PHP 4,000 per day with a PHP 500 daily transport allowance, capped at 5 billable days.



We reward speed and thoroughness. A completion bonus is available based on how quickly all tasks are delivered with quality written reports: PHP 15,000 for completion within 3 days, PHP 10,000 within 5 days, and PHP 5,000 within 7 days. No bonus applies after 7 days.



We also offer PHP 3,000 per category for every quote we end up using from the four areas: electricity connection, gravel road construction, deep well system, and water grid connection — up to PHP 12,000 additional if we use your quotes across all categories. All quotes must include the contractor’s name and contact number for independent verification.



Total compensation ranges from PHP 22,500 (5 days, no bonuses) to PHP 40,500 (completed in 3 days with quotes used across all categories).



To apply, send a short introduction about yourself, where you are based, and any relevant experience.

title: Online Math/Science Teacher(Near-Native Accent)
description:
About Pomelo Academy

Pomelo Academy is an innovative online international school dedicated to delivering high-quality education to students worldwide. We provide a dynamic and engaging learning environment, catering to individualized instruction that transcends geographical boundaries.



Job Description

We are seeking passionate and experienced Near-Native English-speaking Online K-12 Math and/or Science Teachers with verifiable teaching certifications. The ideal candidates will have strong academic backgrounds in Mathematics and/or Science, experience teaching young learners (ages 5–18), and a commitment to creating a supportive, inquiry-based, and engaging online learning environment.



Responsibilities



Deliver interactive and engaging Math and/or Science lessons to individuals and small groups of 2–6 students aged 5–18.

Teach using internationally recognized curricula such as A Closer Look, Glencoe Science, Pearson Interactive Science, NGSS-aligned resources, Singapore Math, or IB/AP/A Level Math programs.

Create age-appropriate lesson plans focused on conceptual understanding, inquiry, problem-solving, and real-world applications.

Incorporate visuals, multimedia, and hands-on virtual activities to make abstract concepts accessible and engaging.

Monitor student progress and provide timely feedback to students and parents.

Foster curiosity, discussion, and active learning in a safe and supportive space.



Qualifications



Professional teacher with at least 2 years of teaching experience (Kindergarten–Grade 12).

Must hold a valid teaching license/certification (e.g., Teaching License, State Certification). TESOL/TEFL is a plus.

Near-native English accent with excellent spoken and written communication skills.

Strong academic background in Mathematics and/or Science (Biology, Physics, Chemistry, General Science).

Experience teaching in public/international schools or reputable online platforms.

Familiarity with inquiry-based and/or interdisciplinary approaches (e.g., STEM/STEAM).

Comfortable working between 07:00–22:00 (Weekdays) and 9:00–22:00 (Weekends), GMT+8.

Proficiency with digital platforms such as ClassIn, Microsoft Office, and other educational technologies.

Must have a stable and fast internet connection and a PC/laptop with at least Windows 10 or Mac OS Catalina.



Benefits



Flexible working hours.

Opportunity to teach using globally respected Math and Science curricula.

Be part of an international, passionate team of educators.

Access to training and professional development.

Regular enrollment model (not a booking system), ensuring schedule stability and consistency

title: AI Agents & Automation Engineer
description:
We’re hiring a hands-on builder who can create real systems using AI tools. You’ll design and deploy AI agents, automations, and LLM-powered workflows that replace manual processes and support internal operations.



This opportunity is best suited for candidates who already have experience building working automations, agent workflows, or internal tools, beyond simply experimenting with AI tools.







What You’ll Do and Deliver:



-Build and maintain AI agents and LLM-powered workflows for real operational use



-Design end-to-end workflows that take action, not just generate responses



-Turn repetitive and manual processes into practical AI-driven automations



-Improve workflow logic, response quality, and reliability across AI-powered processes



-Debug, refine, and optimize existing AI automations for better performance and consistency



-Help turn business needs into usable AI-assisted tools and working solutions

URGENT HIRING



**HIRING: Experienced Cold Caller (Remote)**



We are looking for an experienced Cold Caller to join our team.



**Requirements:**

* Clear and professional English communication skills

* Confident speaking with business owners

* Ability to handle objections and build rapport

* Reliable internet connection and quiet work environment

* Experience with CRM systems is a plus



**To Apply, Please Send:**



1. Your resume

2. A voice recording using the script below

3. A brief summary of your cold-calling experience



**Recording Script:**



Agent: Hi, is this Jane?



Prospect: Yes.



Agent: Hi Jane, this is Mary with Bizwai. I'll be very brief—we work with small business owners, including contractors, to clean up bookkeeping, improve cash flow visibility, and show which jobs are actually making money. Did I catch you at a terrible time?



If they ask what this is about:



"Totally fair. We're reaching out to smaller contractors in Los Angeles because a lot of owners are good at the trade, but the numbers are usually behind—invoices, receipts, payroll, job costs, taxes, and cash flow all get mixed together. We're offering a free financial clarity review to see if anything is leaking profit or creating tax surprises."



Question 1:

"Are you currently using QuickBooks, or are you tracking things another way?"



Question 2:

"Do you usually know after each job whether it actually made the margin you expected?"



Question 3:

"Is collecting payments and keeping cash flow steady ever an issue, or are you pretty comfortable with that?"



If they show any pain:



"That's exactly where we help. We're not just a bookkeeper entering transactions. We help organize the numbers so you can see cash flow, job profit, unpaid invoices, expenses, and taxes before they become a problem."



Meeting Close:



"I think a 15-minute call would be worthwhile. We can quickly look at how your books are set up and show you what we would check first. Would tomorrow or Thursday be better?"



If they hesitate:



"No problem. It is not a sales presentation. It is more of a quick diagnostic. If everything looks good, we'll tell you that. If we see something that can save time, clean up the books, or improve cash flow visibility, we'll show you."



Calendar Close:



"Great. I'll send a calendar invite. What
 should I use?"

title: Executive Assistant — Fast-Paced Startup CEO
description:
The Role

You won't be handed a playbook. You'll help write it.

This role exists because the CEO needs a trusted operator who can absorb context quickly, make good calls with limited information, and execute without hand-holding. You'll sit at the intersection of strategy and execution — owning the CEO's time, filtering noise, moving things forward, and occasionally being the one person who holds the whole picture together.

If you thrive in structure and need clear processes before you act, this isn't the right fit. If you're energised by working at the edge of what you know and figuring things out as you go, keep reading.



What You'll Actually Do

Time & Schedule Management



Own the CEO's calendar with a sharp eye for time efficiency — protect deep work blocks, batch meetings intelligently, and eliminate unnecessary gaps and conflicts

Proactively plan each day before it starts — not reactively managing what lands, but anticipating what's coming and setting the CEO up for it

Brief the CEO before every meeting: context, objective, who's in the room, what outcome is needed

Guard the CEO's time like it's the company's most valuable resource — because it is



Communication



Manage high-volume inbound across
, Slack, and other channels — triage, respond, escalate, or action without being asked

Draft outbound communications on behalf of the CEO — clear, fast, and in the right tone for the audience

Ensure nothing important goes unanswered and no thread gets dropped

Be the connective tissue between the CEO and the Sales, Development, and Marketing teams — keeping information flowing, follow-ups happening, and people accountable



Cross-Team Coordination



Work daily alongside Sales, Development, and Marketing — understand their priorities, track dependencies, and flag anything that needs CEO attention

Run task and project tracking in ClickUp — you'll live in this tool and keep it clean, current, and actually useful

Manage campaigns, automations, and workflows in GoHighLevel (GHL) — this is non-negotiable

Follow up with tea
mbers so the CEO doesn't have to chase anyone



Operations & Projects



Prepare meeting agendas, briefing notes, and action summaries

Handle logistics end-to-end: travel, events, client meetings, team offsites

Manage sensitive commercial, legal, and team information with full discretion

Spot what's falling through the cracks and close the gap before it becomes a problem





What We're Looking For

Non-negotiables:



Proficiency in ClickUp — you use it daily and keep it genuinely organised

Proficiency in GoHighLevel (GHL) — automations, pipelines, workflows, communications

You act before being asked — you anticipate, not react

Exceptional written and verbal communication — fast, clear, and appropriate for the audience

You can shift priorities mid-sentence and not miss a beat

You make confident decisions with incomplete information

Full ownership mentality — no excuses, no blame, just solutions



Strong advantage:



Experience supporting a founder or C-suite executive in a startup environment

Exposure to SaaS, tech, or fast-growth companies

Experience coordinating across Sales, Dev, and Marketing functions

Familiarity with AI tools and a willingness to use them to work smarter





What You Won't Find Here



A slow onboarding with weeks of shadowing before real responsibility

A manager who has time to check in on your progress every day

Rigid processes that tell you exactly what to do





What You Will Find



A CEO who trusts you and gets out of your way once you've earned it

Real proximity to strategy and decision-making

A fast-moving team that cares deeply and gets things done

Genuine career upside as the company scales





How to Apply



A short video introduction (2–3 minutes) — no scripts, no production value needed. Just tell us who you are, why this role, and give us one example of a time you took initiative and made something happen without being asked. Upload to YouTube, Loom, or Google Drive and include the link.

Your CV

One sentence: What does "owning someone's time" mean to you?



Applications without a video will not be considered.

title: Remote Survey Programmer — Voxco / JavaScript Specialist (Market Research)
description:
Remote Survey Programmer — Voxco / JavaScript Specialist (Market Research)

Employer: TKW Research Group (Australia / New Zealand)

Location: Remote — Philippines

Engagement: Independent contractor, full-time equivalent (approx. 40 hrs/week)



The Package — What You’ll Receive



TKW Research Group is a long-standing Australian/New Zealand market research firm, and we’re looking for a Survey Programmer to join us on a long-term contract basis. This is a real partnership, not a transactional gig — and a chance to contribute to something genuinely new in market research. The package reflects that:



• Front-row seat on a voicebot R&D project — you’ll contribute directly to a survey voicebot we’re developing with a tier-1 AI platform partner. Real conversational-AI exposure on your CV.



• Base retainer: ?90,000 – ?140,000 PHP per month, commensurate with experience and voicebot project involvement, paid in arrears.



• 13th-month service bonus equivalent to one month’s base fee, paid every December.

• HMO allowance of up to ?50,000 per year, fully reimbursing premium private health cover for you and one dependent.

• Internet & equipment stipend of ?3,000 per month to support your home office setup.

• 10 days of paid leave per annum after 12 months of service, plus observed Australian public holidays without reduction to your base fee.



• Full training paid by TKW Research Group — structured onboarding plus ongoing platform training (Voxco and related tools) so you can perform at the highest level.



• Direct relationship with senior project managers in Australia/New Zealand — no middle layers, no agency markup.



About the Role



We’re looking for a Survey Programmer who can take complex questionnaires and turn them into clean, well-tested, production-ready survey scripts. You’ll own the scripting pipeline end-to-end: build, test, launch, deliver data.



Direct experience with Voxco is ideal, but we’re equally open to strong programmers from Forsta/Confirmit, Decipher, or Qualtrics who can pick up Voxco quickly — and we’ll fund the training to get you there. What matters more is that you can write real JavaScript (not just drag-and-drop survey builder logic) and that you sweat the details on QA.



The Voicebot Project — What Makes This Different



Alongside your core scripting work, you’ll contribute to something most survey programmers never get to touch: TKW Research Group is partnering with a tier-1 multinational AI platform provider to develop a survey voicebot — conversational AI that conducts genuine, natural-sounding interviews at scale.



Your role on the project: building the underlying survey logic, question structures, routing, and validation rules that the voicebot will run. You’re not expected to be an ML engineer — you’re the survey expert who makes sure the conversational layer asks the right questions in the right order and captures clean data on the other side.



This is genuine R&D work with commercial backing. You’ll be one of a handful of survey programmers globally with hands-on conversational-AI experience on your CV.



What You’ll Do

• Translate questionnaires (Word, PDF, client-supplied) into interactive online and CATI scripts.

• Build complex logic: skip patterns, routing, piping, randomisation, quota management, custom validations.

• Write JavaScript, HTML5 and CSS3 to extend platform functionality where the out-of-the-box tools fall short.

• Test thoroughly — logic, edge cases, mobile rendering, accessibility — before anything goes live.

• Export and format data (SPSS, CSV, Excel) for the analysis team.



What We’re Looking For

• 3+ years programming surveys in a market research agency, fieldwork house, or specialised BPO.

• Strong JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3 — you should be comfortable debugging in browser dev tools.

• Hands-on experience with at least one enterprise platform: Voxco, Forsta/Confirmit, Decipher, or Qualtrics.

• Bonus points for SPSS syntax, Python, SQL, or experience with conjoint/MaxDiff modules.

• Genuine interest in conversational AI — you don’t need ML experience, but you should be curious about how survey methodology and voice AI intersect.

• Reliable home office: high-spec PC, dual monitors preferred, stable internet plus a backup option.

• Strong written English — you’ll be communicating with project managers in Australia and New Zealand.



How to Apply



Send your CV plus a short note covering:

1. The platforms you’ve worked on.

2. The most complex script you’ve built.

3. Your earliest available start date.

4. A sentence or two on why the voicebot project interests you.

title: Senior CATI Operations Manager — Remote, Market Research
description:
Senior CATI Operations Manager — Remote, Market Research

Employer: TKW Research Group (Australia / New Zealand)

Location: Remote — Philippines (Metro Manila or Cebu preferred for talent network access)

Engagement: Independent contractor, full-time equivalent



The Package — What You’ll Receive



TKW Research Group is a long-standing Australian/New Zealand market research firm, and we’re looking for a senior operations leader to take ownership of our CATI call floor — and to help shape what comes next. This is a senior, long-term partnership with a genuine strategic dimension, and the package reflects that:



• Lead the bridge to AI-assisted interviewing — the role includes contributing to a voicebot we’re developing with a tier-1 AI platform partner. Detail below.

• Direct line to the COO — you’ll report straight to the Chief Operating Officer of TKW Research Group. No middle layers.

• Base retainer: ?130,000 – ?180,000 PHP per month, commensurate with seniority, paid in arrears.

• 13th-month service bonus equivalent to one month’s base fee, paid every December.

• HMO allowance of up to ?50,000 per year, fully reimbursing premium private health cover for you and one dependent.

• Internet & equipment stipend of ?3,000 per month to support your home office setup.

• 10 days of paid leave per annum after 12 months of service, plus observed Australian public holidays without reduction to your base fee.

• Full training paid by TKW Research Group — structured onboarding plus ongoing dialler, CATI platform, and methodology training so you can perform at the highest level.

• Real ownership of how the floor runs, working directly with senior ANZ leadership — no middle layers, no agency markup.



About the Role



We run multi-market CATI fieldwork for ANZ and international market research clients, and we’re looking for an experienced operations manager to take ownership of the call floor. You’ll be responsible for fieldwork execution, dialler performance, quota management, and the productivity of our interviewer teams.



This is a senior, deeply hands-on role. You’ll have real autonomy over how the floor runs, but you’re also expected to roll up your sleeves — personally running shifts when needed and working directly with front-line interviewers, not just managing through layers. You’ll be accountable for hitting completion targets, maintaining quality, and keeping projects on budget.



The Hybrid Future — What Makes This Different



Every senior CATI manager knows what’s coming. Voicebots are going to reshape telephone interviewing within the next few years, and operations leaders fall into two camps: those who get sidelined by it, and those who lead the transition. We’re looking for the second kind.



TKW Research Group is partnering with a tier-1 multinational AI platform provider to develop a survey voicebot — conversational AI that can conduct natural-sounding interviews at scale. Your role in this isn’t theoretical: as the voicebot moves from pilot to production, you’ll be the operational lead running the blended human/voicebot floor. D
 which interviews go to human interviewers and which go to the voicebot. Managing quality across both channels. Calibrating the hybrid model to deliver better data than either could alone.



If you’ve been waiting for a CATI role where you get to shape what telephone research becomes — rather than manage its slow decline — this is it.



What You’ll Do



• Manage CATI fieldwork end-to-end: sample distribution, quota matrices, completion tracking.

• Personally run live shifts when required — this is not a desk-only role. You’ll be on the floor (remotely) directing interviewers in real time, especially during critical fieldwork windows and across time zones.

• Monitor dialler performance in real time — contact rates, call dispositions, interviewer yield — and make tactical calls to keep productivity up.

• Coordinate Shift Supervisors, QA staff, and a remote interviewer pool.

• Troubleshoot operational issues live and work directly with the survey programming team when scripts need adjustments.

• Maintain ISO 20252 / ESOMAR-aligned quality processes.

• Produce daily and weekly operational reporting for the COO.



What We’re Looking For



• 7+ years in CATI operations within a market research agency or fieldwork BPO, with 3+ years in a senior management role.

• Strong working knowledge of dialler logic, CATI platforms, and call centre KPIs.

• Genuinely good with front-line interviewers — you can motivate, coach, and direct base-level interviewers directly, not just manage through supervisors. The best candidates have come up through the floor and haven’t lost the common touch.

• Solid grasp of market research methodology: sampling, quotas, weighting basics, and QA standards (ISO 20252, ESOMAR).

• Forward-looking on AI in research — you don’t need technical AI experience, but you should see voicebots as an opportunity to lead, not a threat to manage around.

• Comfortable with flexible shift patterns to cover multi-timezone fieldwork (agreed in advance — not random).

• Home office with reliable power, dual internet connections, and a setup capable of running monitoring tools and video calls daily.

• Strong written and spoken English.



How to Apply



Send your CV plus a short note covering:

1. The largest CATI operation you’ve personally run (team size, markets, sample volumes).

2. The dialler platforms you know best.

3. Your shift flexibility.

4. Your view on how voicebots will reshape telephone interviewing — and where you see your role in that shift.

title: Senior Three.js / WebGL Developer (3D Patio & Roof Configurator)
description:
We're building a browser-based 3D patio and roof configurator that lets homeowners and builders design custom patios in real time and get instant pricing. Users pick a style (flat or gable roof), set dimensions, attach the patio to a house wall, choose materials, colours, gutters, infill panels and more, and the Three.js scene updates live. The app also generates spec sheets and PDF quotes from the configured design.



The 3D side is already functional. We have working flat and gable patio builders, dynamic rafter and beam generation, house attachment, measurement labels, and a server-side rendering path for preview images. Now we want someone strong in Three.js to help us take the 3D experience to the next level.



Current stack

Three.js (WebGL) for all 3D rendering. GLB/GLTF models for houses, roof components, gutters, fascia and more. Vanilla JS with a Babel build pipeline, Express/Node backend, EJS views, Stripe for payments and Firebase for auth.

What you'll work on



Improving geometry accuracy across dynamic rafters and beams, gutters, roof pitch and wall attachment. Parametric model generation that stays correct as dimensions change. GLB model integration, materials, lighting and visual polish. Performance optimisation and clean, maintainable scene code. Fixing edge case bugs in the flat and gable builders.

You should have



Solid hands-on Three.js experience on real projects, not just demos. A good grasp of 3D math including transforms, geometry, materials and lighting. Comfort working in a vanilla JS codebase with no heavy framework. Bonus points for parametric or CAD-style modelling, GLTF/GLB authoring, and performance tuning.



How to apply



Send a short intro, links to your Three.js work or portfolio (live demos strongly preferred), and your availability and expected monthly rate. Applications without portfolio links will not be considered.

title: Customer Support Rep (Fully Remote)
description:
We’re Hiring: Customer Support Rep (Fully Remote)

_____________________________________________________________



A rare opportunity to learn, grow, and help power one of the fastest-growing home brands

_____________________________________________________________



Hi! I’m Lawrence, founder of JazzUpCo - a fast-growing home and dining brand redefining modern tableware and lifestyle across the US. We are now expanding globally, and only just getting started.



Our vision is simple - when people think of beautifully designed, high-quality flatware and homeware, we want them to think of JazzUpCo.



We’ve served over 75,000 customers and we’re growing fast - which means we’re now looking for someone thoughtful, reliable, and eager to grow, to support our operations and customer experience.



You’ll be part of the engine that keeps our day-to-day running smoothly - supporting our customers, organizing backend operations, and helping us improve how we work as we scale.

_____________________________________________________________



Your Role



You’ll with your team lead, and our customers. Your job is to make sure every customer experience is a smooth one - and that our backend operations stay organized as we grow.



_____________________________________________________________



What You’ll Do:



- Respond to customer inquiries via email, social, and chat platforms (we use Gorgias)



- Resolve issues with care and empathy, ensuring customers feel heard and helped



- Coordinate with warehouse and logistics partners to ensure smooth order fulfillment and tracking



- Monitor reviews, identify trends in feedback, and suggest improvements to our systems



- Support daily operations tasks - tracking returns, updating records, and keeping things organized



- Collaborate with the team to improve our SOPs and backend workflows



- Be the voice of the customer - bringing feedback to the team to help us improve



You don’t need to have all the answers - we’ll teach you the tools and systems. What we care about is your attitude: someone eager to learn, grow, and contribute ideas along the way.



_____________________________________________________________



Who We’re Looking For:



- Empathetic & Patient Communicator: You write and speak with warmth and clarity, and genuinely care about helping people.



- Reliable & Detail-Oriented: You keep things organized, catch the little things, and follow through consistently.



- Tech-Savvy & Process-Oriented: You enjoy systems, tools (Notion, Slack, Gorgias etc.), and figuring things out when things aren’t working.



- Eager to Grow: This is a full-time employee role - not a freelance or part-time gig. We’re looking for someone fully committed to growing with us long-term. You won’t be juggling other jobs. Instead, you’ll be part of the team, learning across different areas of the business, gaining new skills, and building something meaningful together.



- Team Player: You work well with others, ask good questions, and love contributing to a positive team vibe.



_____________________________________________________________



Why Work With Us:



- 100% remote, full-time role with paid time off and other benefits



- Learn directly from the founder and team lead with hands-on mentorship



- Join a high-growth brand where your work actually matters - no layers, no red tape



- Be part of a team that values excellence, growth, and fulfillment



_____________________________________________________________



Our Culture



We believe culture fit is key. Skills can be trained, but the right mindset, attitude, and shared values are what make the magic happen here. Our culture is built around 3 pillars:



E — Excel

If we’re going to do something, we do it with care and pride.



F — Fulfilment

We find meaning in the work we do - and how we do it.



G — Growth

We believe everything can be learned. And we’re committed to growing together, day by day.



_____________________________________________________________



The Journey Ahead:



Step 1: Apply - Tell us about yourself through the application form. (Link: forms.gle/xtq97FU5iZNyV9258 )



Step 2: Interview - If shortlisted, we’ll get to know you and see if it’s a good fit for both sides.



Step 3: Trial Task - A short task to see how you approach real situations.



Step 4: Offer & Onboarding - If it’s a match, we’ll kick off with a 60-day onboarding and probation period to get you trained up and integrated into the team.



At the end of this onboarding and probation phase, if we’re aligned and excited to move forward together, your position will be confirmed as a full-time team member - with continued mentorship, support, and a clear path for growth ahead.



_____________________________________________________________



Ready to be part of something exciting?

Apply now - we can’t wait to meet you!

title: Executive Operations Manager

mbers you are the go to person who knows how to or can find out how to make the right things happen for business success. You enjoy and thrive when:

building systems and processes

hiring and managing teams

showing up every day with energy and expertise to move the business forward

nimble to go beyond core duties to contribute to success

What You Will Do



Operations 

You will be the operational backbone of Ice Cream Sunshine — building the systems, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and team structure that keep the business running smoothly and scaling with confidence. You will manage teams, coordinate vendors and partners, and oversee daily operations. You own project timelines and deliver early — always. Guest and customer feedback flows through you and gets translated into clear operational decisions. You set priorities around the highest impact work.



Executive Administrator to the Founder 

You will work directly alongside the founder— managing day to day business and personal needs so the founder stays focused on what matters most. You protect the founder's time by owning routine decisions and flagging only what truly requires owner input. You provide concise operational updates and keep priorities and timelines on track. And at the center of everything you do, you help shape and sustain a good vibes, respectful company culture that everyone on the team is proud to be part of.





What We Are Looking For

Requirements

- 2+ years of team management experience

- 1+ years as an operations manager

- 1+ years budget, bookkeeping, or p&l accountability

- Fluent written and spoken English

- Positive “can do” pro-active personality

- Your own computer with reliable extremely secure high-speed internet

- Outstanding spoken and written communication skills

- Experience developing, implementing, and revising processes and systems

- This is a vendor, team, and client facing role so the candidate selected will have a positive and professional attitude at all times along with a polished professional image and excellent diction. 

- Strong and confident tech skills with the ability to quickly learn and adapt to new platforms and tools

- 5 years minimum experience working with US-based employers





You Go to the Top of Our Candidates If You:

- Don't wait for direction — you create it. You bring ideas, take initiative, and move things forward with your own expertise and instincts

- Have an outstanding understanding of people and technology, and genuinely enjoy finding new tools and solutions that make the business better



What We Offer

$7–$9/hr USD + bonus plan

A direct, collaborative relationship with the founder — your perspective is valued and essential here

A supportive, respectful team environment where people genuinely enjoy working together

A real path to growth as Ice Cream Sunshine scales

Fun times with virtual team events

We treat you to lunch and sweets. :+)

Birthday celebrations??? Yes. We celebrate you.



How to Apply: Cover Letter

We would love to hear from you. A cover letter is required from all applicants.



Begin your cover letter with your first available start date and your availability this week for an interview between 9:00 AM and 11:00 AM CDT. 

*Note: When sharing your availability be sure to have it listed in the Chicago time zone, CDT.



Part One 

Reading the details of the role, why you are applying and what about your background most aligns with this position.



Part Two

1. What has brought you the most fulfillment or joy in previous roles?

2. What is one example of a challenging assignment beyond your core job responsibilities that you were asked to complete — what was it, what did you do, and what was the outcome?

3. What type of work or assignments do you aspire to, yet have not yet done?



Part Three 

What makes a great remote working relationship — and how do you personally show up to make it work? Include how long you have been a full-time remote worker and one or two lessons learned along the way.



Bonus

List two or three of your social media links

Post two or three favorite accounts you follow on socials

For something fun, attach a picture of ice cream ????



In this role you may be asked to take on several tasks that may fall outside of your initial job description for the success of the business. As the business grows additional tea
mbers will be hired and these additional assignments will go to the newly hired tea
mbers. 



Essential qualities: you love to learn and you love to have fun  :+)



The team at Ice Cream Sunshine wishes you joy always.  :+)

We don't want a traditional web developer. Your value is knowing what to build, wiring SEO into the structure, and making it look and convert like a pro did it, not writing custom code.

This is a part-time role starting at around 15-20 hours/week across our current client load. We add new clients regularly, and your hours, pay, and account load grow with us. We want someone who treats BUF like their own agency, not a side gig.

Track lead quality, not just CPL

Weekly reporting with a clear point of view on what's working, what's not, and what's next

Communicate directly with the BUF team via Slack / Loom / call



MUST-HAVES

Strong SEO knowledge: technical, on-page, and content

BONUS

title: Mobile Frontend Engineer — RoseJob
description:
About RoseJob



  RoseJob is job search that actually feels good. Upload your resume, and our matching engine (7-agent resume extraction over ~25K live jobs from 30+ sources) builds your profile — then you swipe through hand-picked roles, each card showing the skills you bring vs. what the job needs. Think "match, bloom, hire." We're early, the backend is real and shipping, and the mobile app is where the product comes alive.

  

  The role



  You'll be our mobile engineer — owning the RoseJob app end to end, from gesture physics to App Store release. This is a craft role: a swipe app lives or dies on feel, so we care as much about a buttery card animation and a delightful loading state (falling petals ? blooming bouquet) as we do about clean architecture. You'll work directly with the founder and the backend/matching team, and you'll have real ownership over how the product looks, moves, and ships.



What you'll build



  - The swipe deck — fluid card gestures (? like, ? pass, ? super-like) with 
ntum, snap-back, and stacking, built on Reanimated + Gesture Handler running on the UI thread at 60fps.

  - The resume-upload ? extraction ? profile-review ? deck flow (our hard invariant: no swiping without a resume), including the document picker, upload states, and the "petals while we think" extraction experience.

  - The match card itself — our killer feature — rendering skill-expression overlaps cleanly and legibly.

  - The saved "bouquet" (liked stack), job detail, and apply hand-off.

  - The whole release pipeline: EAS builds, TestFlight, App Store + Play submissions, OTA updates, and the unglamorous parts (signing, review rejections, staged rollouts).



  Our stack



  Expo · React Native · TypeScript · expo-router · Reanimated · Gesture Handler · Zustand — talking to a FastAPI backend. You don't need to have used every piece, but you should be at home in this world.



  You'll thrive here if you have



  - Shipped real React Native apps to both the App Store and Google Play — and owned the releases, not just the features. (Send us links; we'll open them on a device.)

  - Strong TypeScript + React fundamentals (hooks, state, render performance).

  - Real fluency with gestures and animations — Reanimated worklets, Gesture Handler, 60fps interactions. This role is unusually animation-heavy; show us something that moves.

  - Comfort with the platform realities: iOS vs. Android differences, permissions, push (APNs/FCM), deep links, and surviving App Store review.

  - Enough native depth (Swift/Kotlin) to write or debug a native module and read a crash stack trace when Expo can't cover it.

  - An eye for polish and UX craft — you sweat the empty states, haptics, and the 100ms that makes a swipe feel right.



  Nice to have



  - Consumer / B2C app experience (especially anything swipe-, feed-, or card-based).

  - EAS Build/Submit + OTA update experience.

  - Animation/motion-design sensibility (Lottie, custom transitions).

  - Accessibility (VoiceOver/TalkBack) and i18n.

  - Comfort being the first/only mobile hire — scoping, shipping, and owning quality without a big team around you.

title: Web Developer / Designer who actually uses AI tools (Claude Code etc.)
description:
I run a small digital agency in Australia (web dev, design, AI consulting). I'm looking for someone to join the team long-term, starting with a paid trial.

Here's the honest version of the role. I take a brief from the client, then hand it to you. You take it from there and build the app or site out using AI-assisted development (Claude Code, Cursor, that kind of thing), follow my process, then properly test it before it comes back to me. I'm not looking for someone who waits to be told every step. I want someone who can run with a brief and bring it home.

I also pick up graphic design work from time to time, so an eye for design genuinely matters here. I'm not after someone who can only follow instructions, I want someone who notices when something looks off and knows how to make it look good.

What you need to be genuinely good at:



AI coding tools, Claude Code especially. If you've never used it, this isn't the role for you. I want someone who already builds this way.

WordPress. Real, hands-on stuff (themes, plugins, page builders, fixing other people's messes). A chunk of my clients are on WordPress, so this isn't optional.

Full-stack development AND design sense. You can build it and make it look good. Most people are one or the other. I need both.

A real eye for design. Layout, spacing, typography, colour. You can look at a design and tell whether it works.

Graphic design tools. Photoshop, Illustrator, Canva, Figma, whatever you use. I get graphic design tasks too and I need someone who can handle them.

Testing your own work before handing it over. I shouldn't be the one finding the bugs.

Good written English and clear communication. We'll be working closely.



Nice to have:



React or modern frameworks

Experience working to a brand brief, not just inventing your own style

Comfortable working independently across a few projects



The setup:



Remote, working Philippine business hours (we're only 2 hours ahead in Australia, so it lines up well)

Starts as a paid trial (1 to 3 months) so we can both see if it's a fit

If it works, it becomes permanent and ongoing



To apply, do this or I'll skip you:

Start your message with the word "Emerald" so I know you actually read this. Then tell me:



A project you built using Claude Code or similar. What it was and what you did.

Your WordPress experience, with links if you've got them.

A portfolio or a few examples of your work, including any graphic design.



Thanks,

Jake

We are seeking a full time product sourcer who can grow in our company and later be promoted to a higher paid managerial role. If you are not a hard worker and can't prove it to us over our process, don't even bother completing this application.

10 hours/day, 4 days a week, OR

8 hours/day, 5 days a week



Total: 40 hours per week

You must submit your work schedule upfront — what time you will start, what time your break will be, and what time you end. We expect you to stick to it. Consistency matters here.



COMMUNICATION



All communication will be handled through 
 — you must have it and be active on it.

Communication is required. During your working hours, you are expected to reply promptly. Slow responses during shift are not acceptable.

No formal interview. Instead, you'll be asked a few quick questions over

title: Sales Operations Project Manager
description:
We’re looking for a strong, proactive Sales Operations Project Manager who can lead a sales pod, drive accountability across closers and setters, and maintain seamless communication between Sales, Growth Ops, and Tech Ops.



This is a leadership and coordination role — you are the operational backbone that ensures the pod performs at a high level, SOPs are followed, data is accurate, and every tea
mber stays aligned and supported. If you’re the kind of person who naturally takes ownership, thrives in fast-paced environments, and knows how to communicate with clarity and authority, you’ll excel here.



This is a full-time position, requiring consistent availability from 8am to 4pm Eastern Time, with solid internet, power, and backup.



All applicants must complete DISC and IQ assessments before applying.



Detailed Job Description Breakdown



Pod Leadership & Daily Operations

• Lead and manage the daily workflow of closers and setters to ensure the sales pod operates smoothly.

• Run daily huddles, weekly check-ins, and pipeline reviews with clear agendas and follow-through.

• Manage pod-level projects (e.g., SOP rollouts, funnel changes, tracking fixes) end-to-end, ensuring on-time execution.

• Monitor pod performance, identify bottlenecks early, and escalate issues with solutions—not problems.

• Own the onboarding and offboarding process for new sales staff, including systems access, SOP orientation, and performance expectations.

• Ensure all pod members maintain clean calendars, proper availability, and updated CRM/task workflows.



Quality Assurance, Accountability & Compliance

• Hold closers and setters accountable for submitting accurate EODs, updating dispositions, and following SOPs consistently.

• Conduct quality checks on sales calls, calendar availability, CRM hygiene, and follow-up sequences.

• Audit all sales data regularly (bookings, show rates, sales, payments, renewals) to ensure accuracy before reporting.

• Flag performance gaps early and coach tea
mbers with clarity, empathy, and firmness.

• Ensure all pod documentation, scorecards, and checklists are consistently maintained and up to date.



Cross-Department Coordination

• Work directly with Front-End Tech Ops, Back-End Automation Specialists, and Growth Ops to resolve tech issues, data discrepancies, or workflow breakdowns.

• Communicate updates clearly and quickly across all stakeholders — closers, setters, Growth Ops, SOMs, Tech Ops, and leadership.

• Serve as the bridge for multi-team projects (automation fixes, tracking repairs, new funnels, offer migrations).

• Maintain a strong working relationship with salespeople (who may be impatient or stressed under pressure) while keeping communication tight, professional, and steady.



Reporting & Performance Management

• Prepare weekly and monthly performance reports for leadership, ensuring all numbers are accurate and validated.

• Track KPIs across the full funnel: leads ? setters ? calls ? sales ? renewals.

• Support leadership in evaluating pod performance, identifying improvement plans, and implementing corrective action.

• Ensure the sales pod meets revenue, activity, and quality targets consistently.



Skills & Qualifications

• Project Management experience is mandatory.

(Comfortable managing timelines, action items, dependencies, and follow-through across multiple teams.)

• At least 1–2 years experience in sales operations, sales admin, sales coordination, or a similar leadership/ops role.

• Strong leadership and interpersonal skills — able to hold people accountable with firmness and empathy.

• Excellent verbal and written communication; comfortable leading huddles, giving feedback, and jumping on calls.

• Highly organized, detail-driven, and able to manage multiple moving parts in a fast-paced environment.

• Tech-savvy and comfortable navigating CRM, calendar tools, funnels, spreadsheets, and SOPs.

• Experience working with sales teams (closers/setters) is strongly preferred.

• Solution-oriented, proactive, and able to anticipate problems before they happen.

• Thrives in an environment where communication, speed, and ownership are non-negotiable.



If this sounds like you…



If you love driving clarity, supporting high-performance teams, and being the operational heartbeat of a fast-moving sales pod, we’d love to meet you. This role is perfect for someone who wants to grow into higher-level ops leadership while playing a mission-critical role in our sales organization.



About Sales Possible



At Sales Possible, we partner with mission-driven online coaching companies to build world-class marketing and sales ecosystems. We’re not just a sales team provider — we architect full-funnel systems, optimize performance, and support our clients with cutting-edge automation, AI, and operations infrastructure.



We work with high-growth education brands and expert coaches, helping them scale sustainably while delivering exceptional customer experiences.



We’re a fast-moving, tight-knit team that values ownership, proactive communication, and continuous improvement. If you want to work in an environment obsessed with growth, clarity, and performance — you’ll feel right at home here.

title: Full-Stack Content & Product Marketer (B2B & SaaS)
description:
Role Overview

We operate at the intersection of technical infrastructure and career technology. We run two parallel, high-growth tracks: CDOps Tech (an elite B2B infrastructure firm deploying interim DevOps/SRE squads to top-tier startups) and our upcoming Career Intelligence Platform (a developer-focused SaaS ecosystem).



We are looking for a hybrid, Full-Stack Marketer who lives at the intersection of technical copywriting, WordPress management, visual asset design, and product launch marketing. You will own our entire digital footprint, responsible for translating deeply technical concepts into beautiful, conversion-oriented case studies, social pipelines, and launch loops.



Key Responsibilities

1. B2B Case Studies & Collateral (CDOps Tech)

Interview the founding technical team to distill complex infrastructure achievements (e.g., Kubernetes migrations, downtime reduction, optimizing event-driven architectures) into highly polished, readable case studies and lead magnets.



Write authoritative, peer-to-peer content that commands immediate respect from senior technical decision-makers (CTOs, VPs of Engineering).



2. Product Marketing & Launch Strategy (Career Intelligence Platform)

Build and execute the comprehensive go-to-market (GTM) strategy for the upcoming SaaS platform launch.



Craft the messaging architecture, landing page copy, product walkthrough collateral, and onboarding
 sequences to drive user sign-ups and viral loops.



3. Website Management & Visual Design (WordPress & Figma)

Take complete ownership of our web properties. You will directly update, edit, and optimize our landing pages and publish new case studies within WordPress (using blocks or page builders) without requiring a developer.



Maintain on-page SEO best practices (meta-tags, URL structures, image optimization) using standard WordPress SEO tools.



Design crisp, minimalist visual graphics, presentation decks, and social media templates using Figma or Canva that match our clean, tech-focused brand identities.



4. Social Media & Campaign Management

Manage, write, and schedule a consistent publishing calendar across all official corporate handles (primarily LinkedIn and X/Twitter).



Repurpose long-form case studies and product updates into short-form, high-engagement text posts, threads, and visual carousels.



Requirements & Qualifications

Experience: 3–5+ years of direct experience working as a Product Marketer, Content Lead, or Growth Marketer inside a B2B SaaS, developer-tool, or cloud-infrastructure startup environment.



The Tech Stack: Hands-on mastery of WordPress (including block editors/builders and basic plugin management), design software (Figma/Canva), social schedulers, and basic marketing automation/CRMs (HubSpot/Mailchimp).



Linguistic Technical Fluency: You must comfortably understand basic infrastructure terminology (e.g., DevOps, SRE, cloud scaling, CI/CD pipelines, Kubernetes) so your copy sounds authentic to engineering leaders, not generic.



Creative Multi-Tasker: A distinct portfolio showing a mix of both long-form written work (like case studies or whitepapers) and visual design work (like web layouts or social media assets).



The Style: Zero tolerance for generic corporate buzzwords or marketing fluff. You write with brevity, impact, and absolute clarity.



Note: Only for Philippines Candidates that do not require sponsorship

title: Account Manager
description:
About Rockenue

Rockenue is a technology-powered commercial management company for hotels. We handle revenue management, distribution, sales, and tech implementation for a growing portfolio of properties across Europe.



We're looking for someone with energy, hunger, and common sense — not necessarily a long CV.

You'll take ownership of a portfolio of hotel accounts, acting as the day-to-day point of contact for property partners. You'll produce reports, manage distribution channels, solve problems, and keep everything running smoothly. We'll teach you the hospitality side. What we can't teach is drive, initiative, and the ability to figure things out.

If you're the kind of person who Googles the answer before asking the question, who takes pride in getting things right, and who genuinely gets a buzz from being on top of everything — keep reading.



What You'll Be Doing



Managing a portfolio of hotel accounts end-to-end, acting as the main point of contact for property owners and managers

Producing and delivering regular performance reports to clients

Working inside OTA extranets (
, Expedia, etc.), channel managers, and property management systems daily

Monitoring rate parity, availability, and distribution health across all channels

Coordinating with the internal team on pricing updates, promotions, and new channel activations

Identifying revenue opportunities and flagging underperformance

Using AI tools, chatbots, and automation to streamline workflows and increase output

Learning and mastering new hospitality tech platforms quickly





Who You Are (This Matters More Than Your CV)



Relentless work ethic. You take ownership. You don't clock-watch. When something needs doing, you do it — properly and fast.

Common sense over credentials. You can walk into an unfamiliar situation, assess it logically, and figure out the right move without being hand-held.

Tech-obsessed, not tech-tolerant. You genuinely enjoy learning new systems. Complex dashboards and unfamiliar software excite you rather than intimidate you.

AI is already part of your workflow. You actively use tools like ChatGPT, Claude, or similar to get more done. This isn't optional — it's central to how we work.

Proactive by nature. You spot problems before they're reported. You suggest improvements nobody asked for. You hate sitting idle.

Clear communicator. Excellent written and verbal English. You can explain something simply, flag an issue professionally, and keep a client confident.

Detail-oriented without losing the big picture. You catch the small errors but still understand why they matter commercially.



Hospitality experience is a plus but absolutely not required. If you've never touched a hotel extranet but you're sharp, motivated, and learn fast — we want to hear from you. We will train the right person.



Application Requirements

Your application must include a short video introduction (2–3 minutes) covering:



Who you are and a bit about your background

Why you'd be a great fit for Rockenue specifically

A brief example of how you use AI or automation tools in your current or recent work



Applications without a video will not be considered. This is the single most important part of your application — show us your energy and personality.



Compensation

Competitive monthly salary (paid in GBP/USD), commensurate with experience. Long-term position with real room to grow as the portfolio scales.
