description:
We're growing an English learning app and we're looking for a talented YouTube creator to produce engaging educational videos that teach English to a wide audience. If you know how to make a video that people actually watch until the end, we want to hear from you.



What you'll be doing:



You'll be creating one YouTube video per day of 5 to 10 minutes teaching English (grammar, vocabulary, expressions, pronunciation or anything relevant) and handling everything from A to Z: scripting, filming, editing, designing the thumbnail, writing the title, description and tags to maximize reach. It doesn't have to be complicated — simple works great. You can draw inspiration from what's already performing well on YouTube and put your own spin on it. You work independently and you know what it takes to make a video perform.



What we're looking for:



C1 or C2 level English is a must. We need someone with real YouTube experience who understands the platform, knows how to create eye-catching thumbnails, and has a strong sense of what makes content engaging. Solid editing skills are required. You need to be creative, autonomous and genuinely passionate about teaching.



Compensation:



We pay $2 and 50 cents per video  plus a percentage of the revenue generated through YouTube monetization. The more your videos perform, the more you earn.



How to apply:



You can either send us a video you've already created and posted on YouTube, or create a new one specifically for this application. We strongly prefer the latter — it shows your commitment and gives us a much better sense of who you are as a creator. Deal? Just make a short 1 to 3 minute video teaching something in English — a conversation tip, a grammar rule, an expression, anything you feel comfortable with. Take inspiration from a video that's already working well on YouTube and put your own spin on it. The point is simple: we just want to see if you have what it takes. We'll be looking at your editing, your thumbnail, and how well you manage to keep the viewer engaged.

title: Social Media & Content Assistant
description:
Important notes 



Pay can be negotiated up if work is amazing after 3 months 



You should have a computer for basic editing 



You should have graphic design skills . Canva and photoshop 





———



Undefined Marketing is looking for a highly organized, creative, and dependable Social Media & Content Assistant to support our agency and the clients we serve. We primarily work with construction companies, contractors, home-improvement businesses, and other local service brands.

This role combines social media management, content research, copywriting, graphic design, project coordination, and content-library organization. You will help take content from the idea stage through publishing, while keeping our team, files, and client deliverables organized.



Core Responsibilities



1. Social Media Posting & Platform Management

• Schedule and publish content on Instagram,
, TikTok, YouTube, Google Business Profile, and Yelp.

• Write platform-specific captions, titles, descriptions, hashtags, keywords, and calls to action.

• Upload YouTube videos and Shorts, including thumbnails, titles, descriptions, playlists, and tags when needed.

• Confirm that every post is published correctly, on time, and formatted properly for each platform.

• Maintain an organized content calendar for all clients, including upcoming, scheduled, and published posts.

• Keep a complete record of every posted video, graphic, carousel, and photo.



2. Weekly Content Research, Ideas & Scripts

• Research content ideas within each client’s niche and identify topics we can film every week.

• Find high-performing videos, trends, hooks, formats, and competitor examples that can be adapted for our clients.

• Create organized weekly lists of content ideas for upcoming shoots.

• Develop short-form scripts, opening hooks, talking points, interview questions, calls to action, and shooting-style recommendations.

• Organize reference videos and explain why each example is useful or likely to perform well.

• Research construction, real estate, home improvement, and other local-service industries as assigned.





3. Video Library & Raw Footage Organization

• Review our existing video library and identify footage that can be repurposed into new content.

• Go through raw footage, rename files, organize folders, and prepare clips for our video editors.

• Identify footage that can become Reels, TikToks, YouTube Shorts, long-form videos, before-and-after posts, educational videos, or promotional content.

• Match raw footage with content ideas, scripts, hooks, and editing references.

• Create clear editing notes and content briefs so editors understand the goal, structure, and key message of each video.

• Maintain an accurate production tracker showing each video’s status from idea to publication.



Suggested production stages: Idea | Scripted | Filmed | Sent to Editor | In Revision | Approved | Scheduled | Published | Repurposed | Archived





4. Canva Graphic Design & Digital Resources

• Create professional, on-brand graphics for our agency and clients using Canva.

• Design Instagram carousels, educational posts, promotional graphics, testimonials, before-and-after posts, service graphics, holiday posts, Stories, and YouTube thumbnails.

• Create useful downloadable resources, including e-books, guides, checklists, lead magnets, and client educational materials.

• Follow each client’s brand guidelines, including logos, fonts, colors, photo style, and overall visual direction.

• Proofread all graphics and verify names, phone numbers, websites, pricing, and calls to action before approval.



5. Performance Tracking & Reporting

• Track the performance of posted videos, graphics, carousels, and photos.

• Monitor views, reach, engagement, watch time, retention, shares, saves, comments, follower growth, and leads when available.

• Identify the best-performing hooks, topics, formats, lengths, and editing styles.

• Maintain a library of winning posts that can be recreated, updated, or repurposed.

• Prepare organized weekly or monthly performance summaries and recommend what the team should create next.



6. Photo Editing Coordination & Team Support

• Coordinate with our photo editor to make sure client photos are assigned, edited, reviewed, and completed on time.

• Provide editors with the correct footage, photos, logos, brand assets, instructions, references, and deadlines.

• Review completed work for missing files, incorrect logos, spelling mistakes, formatting issues, or missed instructions.

• Follow up on revisions and help keep projects moving without unnecessary delays.

• Maintain organized client folders, content calendars, asset libraries, and project-management boards.



Qualifications

• Experience managing social media for a business, agency, creator, or client account.

• Strong written English, grammar, proofreading, and communication skills.

• Experience using Canva and creating polished, professional graphics.

• Working knowledge of Instagram,
, TikTok, YouTube, Yelp, and Google Business Profile.

• Strong online research skills and the ability to recognize strong hooks, trends, and content formats.

• Excellent organization, attention to detail, and follow-through.

• Experience using Google Drive, Dropbox, Google Sheets, or similar tools.

• Ability to manage multiple clients, assignments, and deadlines at the same time.

• Ability to work independently, communicate clearly, and ask useful questions when needed.

• Reliable computer, stable internet connection, and consistent availability.

Preferred or Bonus Skills

title: Mortgage Support (Associate/Specialist/Sr. Associate) from (CA/US/UK/PH/AU etc) – Australian Market
description:
Location: Fully Remote - Work From Home

Job Type: Full-Time

Salary: Competitive, commensurate with experience and role placement



About Our Company



Your Virtual Partner (YVP) is a premier outsourcing and smart staffing solutions company specializing in connecting global talent with high-performing businesses across Australia. We operate as a seamless, virtual extension of our clients' teams, allowing them to scale their operations effortlessly, maximize productivity, and focus on growth.



While we provide tailored outsourcing across various corporate sectors, our core expertise lies in the financial services space. The vast majority of our clients are top-tier professionals within the Australian Mortgage Broking Industry—including residential brokerages, commercial finance firms, and non-bank lenders. Due to rapid expansion and an increasing demand for premium administrative and processing support from our AU broker clients, we are looking for dedicated financial professionals to join our high-performing global workforce.



About the Opportunities



To make our application process seamless, we have consolidated our current hiring needs into a single open application portal. We are actively building out our deal teams and have three (3) distinct career streams available, depending on your professional experience, lending specialization (Residential vs. Commercial), and technical skill set.

Review the profiles below to identify which stream matches your background, and indicate your preferred option when submitting your application.



[CAREER 1] MORTGAGE SUPPORT ASSOCIATE (Residential Focus – Entry to Mid-Level)



Role Overview: The Mortgage Support Associate plays an essential role in helping individuals and families secure residential financing for their homes. Your primary responsibility is to serve as an operational anchor, guiding clients through the intricacies of the home loan application and origination process. You will evaluate client financial goals, match them with suitable loan products, gather critical documentation, and manage files through to underwriter approval while maintaining strict adherence to regulatory standards.



Key Responsibilities:

- Customer Consultation & Guidance: Meet with potential borrowers to explore financial goals, assess mortgage needs, and provide clear guidance on suitable home loan products, interest structures, and lending terms.

- Application & Loan Processing: Assist borrowers with completing comprehensive mortgage applications and meticulously collect all required supporting documents (including income statements, credit reports, and property appraisals).

- Pre-Qualification Assessment: Evaluate borrower financial profiles to determine eligibility across various residential programs and issue formal pre-qualification letters to assist clients in their property search.

- Product Selection & Loan Structuring: Stay continuously updated on diverse mortgage loan products, shifting interest rates, and individual lender guidelines to structure loans that perfectly balance client goals with lending criteria.

- Credit Counseling & Advice: Help clients interpret credit reports, identify viable strategies to improve credit scores, and advise them on how their unique credit history influences their borrowing options.

- Stakeholder Communication: Maintain proactive, regular contact with borrowers, keeping them informed of file status, missing documents, or processing milestone updates.

- Relationship Management: Cultivate and support robust professional relationships with real estate agents, property appraisers, title companies, and lender underwriters.

- Compliance & Ethics: Execute all origination and filing activities in strict compliance with federal and state laws, maintaining the highest ethical standards under the Best Interest Duty (BID).



Ideal Qualifications for this Stream:

- Prior experience in banking, mortgage administration, or customer financial services.

- General knowledge of residential lending products, interest rate lock-in procedures, and credit files.

- Exceptional communication and customer service skills, with a passion for helping clients navigate complex financial journeys.

- Strong ethical grounding and attention to compliance detail.



[CAREER 2] MORTGAGE SUPPORT SPECIALIST (Commercial & Non-Conventional Lending)



Role Overview: We are seeking a highly specialized, detail-oriented Mortgage Support Specialist with direct experience in the Australian commercial real estate, private lending, and development finance sectors. In this role, you will serve as the technical and operational backbone of our commercial deal team. You will support brokers through highly complex non-conventional funding structures, ensuring applications meet stringent institutional and private standards and moving high-value files smoothly from initial intake to settlement.



Key Responsibilities:

- End-to-End Commercial Deal Support: Manage processing and administrative requirements for a diverse portfolio of Australian commercial, private, and specialized development finance files.

- Application Packaging: Prepare and assemble highly comprehensive, professional loan application packages for submission to a panel of Australian private lenders, non-bank lenders, and specialist development finance institutions.

- Advanced Document Validation: Meticulously collect, review, and analyze complex commercial and corporate document packages, including:

- Financial Data: Australian Business Number (ABN) records, corporate tax returns, Notices of Assessment (NOA), and Business Activity Statements (BAS).

- Property Records: Valuations from registered Australian valuers, formal Title Searches, and local council planning permits.

- Project Files: Detailed development appraisals, construction costings, sales/revenue forecasts, and full project feasibilities.

- Pre-Assessment & Underwriting Support: Assist in the initial underwriting phase, assessing deal viability against specific, strict Australian lender criteria before submission.

- Professional B2B Liaison: Act as the primary point of contact for sophisticated clients and institutional introducers (mortgage brokers, financial planners, commercial accountants), providing technical updates on deal progress.

- Network Coordination: Manage communication and document flows between Australian-based valuers, commercial solicitors, conveyancers, and accounting professionals.

- Rigorous Compliance & Due Diligence: Conduct comprehensive Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing (AML/CTF) and Know Your Client (KYC) checks in absolute alignment with AUSTRAC regulations and Australian Credit Licence (ACL) obligations. Ensure all commercial files comply with the National Consumer Credit Protection (NCCP) Act where applicable.



Ideal Qualifications for this Stream:

- Direct, proven experience supporting brokers or lenders within the Australian commercial real estate or development finance market.

- Deep proficiency in reading and validating corporate financials (ABN, BAS, NOA) and understanding commercial project metrics (feasibility models, construction drawdowns).

- Comprehensive familiarity with AUSTRAC compliance, KYC workflows, and non-bank lending standards.

- Exceptional analytical capacity and sharp attention to detail.



[CAREER 3] MORTGAGE SUPPORT – SR. ASSOCIATE (Residential Expertise & Team Leadership)



Role Overview: We are seeking an experienced and leadership-minded Mortgage Support - Sr. Associate with extensive expertise in the Australian residential mortgage industry. This role requires an advanced understanding of loan structuring, credit policy, and client relationship management. Beyond managing high-tier and complex files, you will demonstrate leadership qualities by driving process optimization, staying on top of tech-stack integrations, and mentoring junior tea
mbers to ensure the overall operational team maintains premium quality output.



Key Responsibilities:

- Advanced Pre-Qualification: Conduct initial high-net-worth client consultations to map out homeownership strategies; evaluate complex serviceability and creditworthiness using tools like Quickli and applying the 5 Cs of Lending.

- Complex Loan Structuring: Educate clients on advanced loan combinations and recommend optimal solutions tailored to multi-property portfolios, expertly balancing fixed vs. variable splits and flexible repayment terms.

- CRM & Pipeline Management: Guide clients smoothly through applications while managing files end-to-end utilizing advanced mortgage CRM platforms such as Salesforce, Creatio, and Salestrekker.

- Secure Document Workflows: Oversee the secure and rapid execution of digital documentation utilizing platforms such as DocuSign and Ezidox, ensuring zero data-integrity errors.

- Post-Closing & Settlement Excellence: Coordinate final document compilation to guarantee frictionless loan settlements; support clients post-settlement with direct debit structures, offset account setups, and ongoing client care.

ntorship & System Optimization: Act as an escalation point and mentor for junior support staff; spearhead internal process improvements to accelerate client onboarding and minimize application turnaround times.

mbers, reviewing loan files for quality assurance, or leading process improvements.

title: Interior Design Technical Officer
description:
REMOTE — Design Development Designer

Singapore-Based Interior Design Practice



We are a Singapore interior design practice with a portfolio spanning residential, hospitality, and commercial projects. We are looking for a designer based in the Philippines who can take a design from intent to a fully resolved, buildable drawing set — and who brings enough technical intelligence to the process that problems are caught on paper, not on site.



This role sits at the intersection of design and documentation. You will receive 3D base models, mood references, and sketches, and from these you will develop the full working drawing package. The expectation is not just to draw what you're given — it's to think through what you're drawing, flag what doesn't work, and ensure every design decision has been resolved before a line goes down.





What you'll be doing



— Developing working drawings and construction details from 3D models, mood imagery, and design sketches provided by the studio

— Reading spatial intent from reference material and translating it accurately into fully dimensioned, coordinated drawings

— Identifying construction and buildability issues at drawing stage — before they become site problems

— Raising design questions proactively when a decision hasn't been made or a detail can't be executed as implied

— Producing plans, elevations, sections, joinery details, ceiling and lighting layouts, and finish schedules

— Managing drawing revisions clearly and maintaining well-organised, version-controlled file sets

— Coordinating with the principal designer through iterative review cycles





What we're looking for



— Degree in Interior Design, Architecture, or related field

— Minimum 4 years of experience producing working drawings and construction details for interior fit-out projects

— The ability to read a 3D model or sketch and understand what it means in construction — not just what it looks like

— Advanced AutoCAD proficiency — this is the core tool for this role

— Working knowledge of SketchUp for model navigation and spatial reference; Revit is a plus

— Experience detailing joinery, built-in furniture, wall cladding, ceiling systems, and custom elements

— A habit of asking the right questions before executing, not after

— Excellent written and spoken English; comfortable on video calls and in async written communication

— Reliable, organised, and self-directed in a remote working environment





What we offer



— Competitive remote salary: ?75,000–?110,000/month depending on experience

— 13th month pay (statutory)

— Working hours with reasonable overlap with Singapore time (SGT)

— Genuine design development work — not repetitive template drafting

— A direct working relationship with the studio principal

— Long-term engagement for the right person





How to apply



Send your CV and portfolio to 
 with the subject line: DD Designer — [Your Name]



Your portfolio must include working drawings and construction details you have personally produced — plans, elevations, sections, and joinery or built-in details. Submissions showing only renders or mood boards will not be reviewed. If you have examples where your drawing process identified and resolved a design or construction issue, we would love to see those.

title: Content Creator – English Teaching
description:
We're building an English learning app and we're looking for a content creator who knows how to make short-form video work.

What you'll be doing:



Every day, you'll create 3 short-form videos around the English learning niche and post them across TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts, plus 1 carousel post on Instagram. You handle everything: concept, filming, editing, posting. No micromanagement, no hand-holding. Just great content, consistently.



What we're looking for:



 You know TikTok, Instagram and YouTube inside out. You have real experience creating content, fast with editing (CapCut, Canva, whatever works for you), and you genuinely enjoy teaching. You spot trends, you move fast, and you care about the results.

$1.50 per post. With 3 videos posted across 3 platforms and 1 carousel daily, that's $6 a day and around $180 a month. A solid side income that fits around your other projects.

To apply, you must record a 30 to 60 second video teaching anything related to English learning. Think a grammar trick, a pronunciation tip, a common mistake, a slang breakdown, a cultural reference, anything that would make someone stop, watch, and save. You can use AI to help you with the script or ideas. One of the best approaches? Find a format that's already working for another creator, take inspiration from it, and make it your own — that's actually how great content is made. What matters is that it feels like you.

title: Remote Senior Laravel Backend or Full Stack Developer
description:
About DigitalTolk

DigitalTolk is an organisation and company that works to make an impact. Our purpose is to give a voice to those who don’t speak the local language; we arrange translators so that patients can get medical treatments in their new country and communicate with doctors. We arrange translators for crime victims so that they can get justice. Our job is to arrange interpreters through our platform for our customers.



Our end customers are hospitals, courts/lawyers, and municipalities who communicate with refugees and other people in need.



Our company purpose is to use technology to make the world a better place. And we’re currently hiring developers to join us on this journey!



We are a company based in Sweden with developers in all parts of the planet!



Job Description

We are looking for a highly skilled Laravel Developer to collaborate with a team of designers and developers to create web applications, platforms and solutions for our own products (some of which are customer facing, others which are for internal use). You will be responsible for developing the backend and unit test of the web applications. The ideal candidate has strong communication skills and ability to create testable, reusable, and scalable code.



We are looking for developers both on the backend side and front end side using Laravel, and Vue/Vuex. Experience using Next/Next or React is beneficial but not mandatory.



For backend we are looking for those who have a passion for coding, understanding of different architecture, and design patterns, experience using redis, and using queues like Redis, Kafka, SQS, Laravel Queues or RabbitMQ. We are seeking Devs who have experience with putting up architecture, preferably experience with microservices (or different types of architecture), working with Serverless and working with the core infrastructure, and passionate about working with Laravel.

title: Senior Shopify Support Engineer (Storefront Operations)
description:
Senior Shopify Support Engineer (Storefront Operations)

Location: Philippines (Remote)



About the Role

We support a large-scale Shopify retail operation spanning hundreds of storefronts and are looking for a highly technical Shopify operator to help maintain storefront quality, troubleshoot issues, identify recurring patterns, and work closely with engineering teams.



This role sits at the intersection of Shopify operations, technical support, quality assurance, and engineering. You'll investigate issues, determine root causes, make low-risk fixes directly within Shopify, and coordinate with engineering teams on larger technical problems.

The ideal candidate has experience supporting Shopify stores at scale and enjoys solving technical problems, improving operational reliability, and preventing issues before they impact customers.



Why Join Us

For more than 15 years, our leadership team has partnered with thousands of talented professionals across the Philippines to build and support high-performing teams serving global clients.

We believe exceptional careers are built through long-term relationships, continuous learning, and sustainable growth. We invest in our people, provide opportunities to expand technical and operational expertise, and create an environment where strong performers can take on increasing ownership and responsibility over time.

This role offers the opportunity to work directly with experienced US-based operators, engineers, and ecommerce leaders while developing deep expertise in Shopify, storefront operations, technical troubleshooting, and large-scale ecommerce systems.



Responsibilities

 • Review and audit Shopify storefronts to identify issues affecting customer experience, merchandising, pricing, checkout flows, integrations, content, and site functionality.

 • Investigate storefront, theme, catalog, inventory, and integration issues and determine root causes.

 • Resolve low-risk issues directly within Shopify when appropriate.

 • Create detailed bug reports, reproduction steps, and technical escalation tickets for engineering teams.

 • Work closely with QA, engineering, merchandising, and operations teams to drive issues through resolution.

 • Support storefront launches, feature rollouts, platform enhancements, and operational changes.

 • Identify recurring issues across multiple storefronts and help improve processes, documentation, and quality standards.

 • Track issues through resolution and validate fixes before closure.

 • Contribute to operational documentation, troubleshooting guides, and knowledge-sharing initiatives.

 • Proactively identify opportunities to improve storefront reliability, operational efficiency, and issue prevention.



Requirements

 • 4+ years of experience supporting Shopify or ecommerce storefronts in a technical capacity.

 • Strong experience with Shopify Admin and Shopify storefront operations.

 • Working knowledge of Liquid, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and browser developer tools.

 • Experience troubleshooting storefront, theme, integration, catalog, inventory, or checkout-related issues.

 • Ability to investigate root causes and independently diagnose technical problems.

 • Experience creating detailed bug reports and working closely with engineering teams.

 • Strong written communication, documentation, and organizational skills.

 • Experience supporting multiple storefronts simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.

 • Strong sense of ownership and accountability from issue identification through resolution.



Preferred Backgrounds

We are particularly interested in candidates with experience in:

 • Shopify Support Engineering

 • Shopify Technical Support

 • Shopify Technical Operations

 • Shopify Implementation

 • Ecommerce Solutions Engineering

 • Shopify Agencies or Shopify Plus Agencies

 • Ecommerce Agencies

 • Ecommerce Platform Support

 • Ecommerce QA



Nice to Have

 • Shopify Plus experience.

 • Experience supporting dozens or hundreds of storefronts simultaneously.

 • Experience with Contentstack or other headless CMS platforms.

 • Familiarity with tools such as Jira, Linear, Datadog, Sentry, New Relic, Splunk, LogRocket, or FullStory.

 • Experience with product catalog management, inventory systems, order management systems, or PIM platforms.

 • Experience supporting storefront launches and migrations.

 • SQL or basic analytics experience.



What Success Looks Like

In this role, you become a trusted technical operator helping maintain the health and quality of a large-scale Shopify ecosystem.

Success means consistently identifying root causes, resolving issues efficiently, reducing recurring i
, improving operational processes, and helping deliver a reliable ecommerce experience across hundreds of storefronts.

You will build deep expertise in Shopify operations, storefront troubleshooting, ecommerce infrastructure, and cross-functional collaboration while partnering closely with QA, operations, and engineering teams.



Ideal Candidate

You've supported multiple Shopify storefronts, either within a Shopify agency, ecommerce agency, implementation partner, or ecommerce brand. You're comfortable troubleshooting issues independently, making low-risk fixes when appropriate, and working closely with engineering teams on larger technical problems.

You have strong systems-thinking skills, can identify patterns across multiple stores, and take ownership of issues from discovery through resolution. You enjoy solving problems, improving processes, and helping maintain a high-quality ecommerce experience at scale.

You're looking for a long-term opportunity where you can continue developing your technical expertise, expand your impact, and grow alongside a team that values ownership, learning, and operational excellence.



What We Value

 • Ownership and accountability

 • Continuous learning and professional growth

 • Clear and proactive communication

 • Long-term thinking

 • High-quality, sustainable work

 • Team-first collaboration

 • Curiosity and problem solving



This is a long-term opportunity for someone who enjoys solving complex technical problems, improving ecommerce operations, and building a career within Shopify and large-scale ecommerce support.

title: Senior Video Editor — Full-Time Remote
description:
We are hiring a professional, independent, full-time Senior Video Editor with 4+ years of experience creating high-performing short-form content for paid social, fashion, beauty, lifestyle, or e-commerce brands.



This is not a junior role. We are looking for someone who can take ownership, move fast, think creatively, and deliver polished work without constant supervision.



Apply only if you are genuinely strong in these areas:



1. Short-form video editing

Clean, premium, fast-paced 9:16 editing with strong hooks, pacing, transitions, sound design, captions, and visual taste.



2. CapCut and Adobe Premiere Pro

You must be highly comfortable editing in CapCut Desktop and/or Adobe Premiere Pro. You should be fast, organized, and able to deliver polished short-form videos without needing step-by-step guidance.



3. Social media trend awareness

You actively follow Reels, TikTok, and paid social trends. You understand what is performing now, which sounds are breaking, and why certain creatives convert.



Bonus: AI video tools

Experience with AI tools such as Higgsfield, Seedance, Runway, Kling, Pika, ElevenLabs, or similar tools is a strong bonus, but not required. If you are curious, dedicated, and willing to learn AI-assisted video workflows, that is also valuable.



You do not need to be perfect at everything from day one, but you must be excellent at editing, independent, serious, and willing to improve fast.



Do not apply if:

You have less than 4 years of professional video editing experience.

You have not edited short-form content for paid social, e-commerce, brand accounts, or high-volume content teams.

You do not have a recent portfolio of clean 9:16 edits.

You need training on basic editing fundamentals.

You cannot work independently and manage your own output.

You are weak on hooks, pacing, or sound design.

You do not follow Reels and TikTok trends daily.

You are unwilling to test, improve, and adapt quickly.

You cannot handle high-volume creative production.





What you will do:

Create 10–12 finished 9:16 videos per day for Meta, TikTok, and Reels.

Build multiple creative variations from the same base footage.

Create scroll-stopping hooks and strong first 1.5 seconds.

Edit clean, premium short-form videos with tight cuts and strong pacing.

Add captions, sound design, transitions, music, and visual polish.

Select trending and relevant sounds for each creative.

Develop 3–5 new creative concepts per week.

Work with a premium fashion, beauty, and lifestyle visual standard.

Take ownership of your work without needing constant instructions.

Bonus: use AI tools to generate or enhance footage when useful.

Required experience and skills:

4+ years of professional video editing experience.

Proven experience editing short-form videos for paid social, brand accounts, e-commerce, or lifestyle/fashion/beauty brands.

Strong portfolio of recent 9:16 videos.

Excellent understanding of hooks, pacing, retention, and conversion-focused editing.

Strong sense of visual taste: premium, clean, modern, minimal.

Strong skills in CapCut Desktop and/or Adobe Premiere Pro.

Strong understanding of Reels and TikTok trends.

Ability to create many variations without making the work feel repetitive.

Native-level or fluent English.

Ability to work full-time remotely.

Minimum 4 hours daily overlap with CET time zone.

Reliable internet connection: 50+ Mbps.

Strong computer setup: M-series Mac or RTX 3060+ PC, 16GB+ RAM minimum.

Bonus: experience with AI video or voice tools such as Higgsfield, Seedance, Runway, Kling, Pika, ElevenLabs, or similar.





Compensation:



This is a full-time remote role with a fixed base salary plus performance-based bonuses.



Bonuses are based on output quality, speed, creative performance, reliability, and ability to consistently produce winning creatives.



To apply:



Send all 6 items below. Missing anything means your application will not be reviewed.



Portfolio link.

Two examples of clean short-form edits.

Which tool you mainly use: CapCut Desktop, Adobe Premiere Pro, or both.

List 5 sounds currently trending on Reels or TikTok and explain in one sentence why each one is working.

Earliest start date and your expected monthly full-time salary.



Confirm this exact phrase:

“I read the full post and I am genuinely experienced in short-form video editing, social media trends, and high-volume creative production.”



Then answer this in 2 sentences:



What makes a hook stop the scroll, and how do you create 20 distinct variations from one base video without making them feel repetitive?



Copy-paste cover letters will be rejected.



Qualified candidates will receive a paid test task.

title: Content Creator (Social Media + Blog)
description:
ABOUT KEYSTONE CLICK



Keystone Click is a Milwaukee-based B2B digital marketing agency specializing in manufacturing, construction, skilled trades, and professional services. We are a close-knit, fully remote team that operates with intention, accountability, and a commitment to delivering real results for our clients. We move fast, communicate clearly, and invest in the people who help us grow.



ROLE OVERVIEW



We are looking for a creative, detail-oriented Content Creator & Social Media Specialist to join our team on a part-time basis. In this role, you will be responsible for writing blog content, crafting social media posts, and publishing content across platforms on behalf of Keystone Click and our clients. A working knowledge of SEO best practices from a content perspective is a strong plus — we want someone who understands how good writing and strategic keywords work together to drive visibility and results.



This is a hands-on production role. You will not just draft content — you will be expected to publish and manage it as well.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Write engaging, on-brand blog posts for Keystone Click and client accounts

Create platform-appropriate social media content (LinkedIn,
, Instagram, etc.)

Publish and schedule content across blogs and social media platforms

Apply basic on-page SEO principles to written content — including keyword integration, meta descriptions, and proper heading structure

Maintain a consistent posting cadence aligned to content calendars

Collaborate with the broader team on content themes, campaigns, and client messaging

TEAM RHYTHM & COMMUNICATION



At Keystone Click, we stay aligned through consistent, structured team touchpoints. As a member of our team, you will be expected to participate in the following:



Daily Morning Huddle (15 Minutes)

Every weekday morning, the full team connects for a quick 15-minute check-in. This is a non-negotiable part of being on the Keystone Click team. The huddle keeps everyone informed, aligned, and accountable — and ensures we move through the day with clear priorities.



Monday Weekly Alignment Meeting

Mondays are our most important tea
eting of the week and run longer than the standard daily huddle. During this session, we review company-based scorecards, align on weekly priorities, and set the tone for the days ahead. You will be expected to come prepared with a status update on your content workload and any flags or needs for the week.



Participation in both the daily huddle and the Monday alignment meeting is required for all tea
mbers, regardless of hours worked.



QUALIFICATIONS



Required

-Strong written English communication skills — clear, concise, and professional

-Demonstrated experience writing blog posts, social media captions, or marketing copy

-Ability to write in different brand voices and adapt to various industries

-Comfortable publishing content natively on platforms (LinkedIn,
, WordPress, etc.)

-Reliable internet connection and ability to attend video meetings during Central Time business hours

-Self-starter with strong organizational habits and the ability to manage deadlines independently



Preferred / Nice to Have

-Working knowledge of SEO content strategy — keyword integration, heading hierarchy, meta descriptions

-Experience with tools like Rank Math, Yoast, or similar SEO plugins

-Familiarity with scheduling and publishing tools (Buffer, Hootsuite, GoHighLevel, or similar)

-B2B content writing experience, especially in trades, manufacturing, or professional services

Experience writing for WordPress or similar CMS platforms



WHAT WE OFFER



Fully remote, flexible part-time schedule

$5.00 per hour compensation

Paid 8 PH Holidays

A collaborative, supportive team that values your contributions

Real-world experience creating content for B2B brands across multiple industries

A structured, communicative work environment with clear expectations

title: IT Project Manager
description:
We're looking for a IT Project Manager to support delivery of critical infrastructure, security, and internal systems initiatives across a fast-moving AI-native healthcare platform. This is not a generalist PM role. You will work directly alongside engineers and IT leadership to coordinate complex technical workstreams, manage dependencies across teams and vendors, and keep execution visible and accountable at every stage.



The right person for this role has a background in IT system rollouts, security or compliance programs, internal platform migrations, or technical vendor implementations. If your project history lives primarily in marketing campaigns, product launches, or business operations coordination, this role is not the right fit.



Why You'll Want to Join:

- You will be paid in USD (bi-monthly: every 15th and 30th)

- Paid Time Off in accordance with company policy

- Observance of Holidays per company guidelines

-100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive

- Direct exposure to infrastructure and security work inside an early-stage AI healthcare company

- High-ownership role where your execution directly determines what ships and when



What You'll Work On:

1. Project Planning and Execution

- Translate ambiguous executive direction into structured execution plans with clear milestones, ownership, and dependencies

- Own end-to-end project timelines and drive accountability across stakeholders without being asked

- Proactively identify risks, dependencies, and bottlenecks before they become blockers

- Escalate thoughtfully and with context when situations require leadership input

- Maintain documentation and visibility systems that enable repeatable, consistent execution



2. Technical Coordination and Delivery

- Partner with engineering and IT leads to break technical initiatives into executable project plans

- Track technical dependencies across infrastructure, vendors, and internal teams

- Coordinate delivery timelines for technical implementations and rollouts

- Ensure technical decisions and risks are documented and communicated clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

- Maintain accurate status across remediation boards and visibility systems so leadership never has to chase updates



3. Meetings and Communication

- Lead project meetings and synthesize discussions into clear action items and written summaries

- Communicate clearly with internal teams and external vendors throughout delivery

- Translate engineering and IT progress into plain language updates for leadership and cross-functional partners



4. Technical Workstreams You Will Own

- Security remediation programs and infrastructure improvements

- Cloud environment buildouts and internal platform rollouts

- Device management initiatives including tablets, endpoints, and related tooling

- IT tooling implementations and vendor integrations

- Internal system migrations and operational infrastructure upgrades



What You Bring:

- 3+ years of experience owning complex cross-functional technical projects

- Demonstrated background in at least one of the following: IT system rollouts, security or compliance programs, internal platform migrations, or technical vendor implementations

- Proven ability to operate effectively in ambiguous environments without a defined playbook

- Strong written communication with high attention to detail

- Track record of driving stakeholders and maintaining accountability without heavy oversight

- Comfort working directly alongside engineers and IT specialists

- Ability to understand technical discussions around infrastructure, security, and systems and translate them into clear plans and progress updates

- High ownership mindset and bias toward action over process



Nice to Have:

- Experience inside a healthcare, healthtech, or regulated industry environment

- Familiarity with security frameworks or compliance programs such as SOC 2, HIPAA, or similar

- Experience managing device management or endpoint rollout programs

- Background working in an early-stage or high-growth startup



How to Apply:

Please include:

- Your updated resume

- A short Loom video (1 to 2 minutes) walking through a technical project you owned end to end, what the workstream involved, how you managed dependencies and risks, and what the outcome was



Only candidates who submit a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.



If you are a technical project manager who thrives in ambiguity, knows how to keep complex infrastructure work on track, and wants direct impact inside a company building something that matters in healthcare, this role gives you the ownership and the environment to do your best work.

title: Credentialing Specialist (Part Time)
description:
Clarity Works is seeking an experienced Credentialing Specialist to support provider enrollment and payer credentialing projects on part timebasis. THIS IS NOT A FULL TIME ROLL. The Credentialing Specialist will be engaged when new credentialing projects arise, such as onboarding new providers, enrolling with commercial insurance plans, revalidations, roster updates, or resolving credentialing-related issues.



TO APPLY:

Please submit your resume and give a brief explanation of your experience in credentialing.  If you do not have credentialing experience, please do not apply for this role.



This person will be responsible for managing the credentialing process from intake through submission, follow-up, and approval, while keeping documentation organized and communicating progress clearly. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, proactive, and experienced working with payer portals, CAQH, NPPES, PECOS, and provider enrollment workflows.



In your application, please detail your experience with medical billing process, healthcare, credentialing, etc.



Key Responsibilities



Complete payer enrollment and credentialing applications for individual providers and group practices

Gather and review all required provider documentation, including licenses, malpractice insurance, W-9s, NPIs, DEA, board certifications, and supporting forms

Maintain and update CAQH profiles and ensure attestations are completed on time

Submit credentialing and recredentialing applications to commercial payers, Medicare, Medicaid, and other networks as needed

Follow up with payers on submitted applications and resolve missing items, rejections, and delays

Track application status, submission dates, effective dates, and payer responses

Communicate project updates, outstanding requirements, and risks clearly to the Clarity Works team

Assist with ERA/EFT enrollment and related payer setup tasks when needed

Maintain organized records of all submissions, confirmations, and approvals

Support revalidations, demographic updates, roster changes, and payer terminations when assigned



Qualifications



2+ years of provider credentialing or payer enrollment experience

Strong working knowledge of CAQH, NPPES, PECOS, Availity, and major payer portals

Experience credentialing providers with commercial insurance, Medicare, and Medicaid plans

Strong understanding of provider enrollment timelines, payer requirements, and common credentialing issues

Excellent organization and follow-up skills

Ability to manage multiple projects and keep accurate records

Strong written and verbal communication skills

Experience in behavioral health, mental health, primary care, or multi-provider practices is a plus



Work Arrangement

This is a project-based, as-needed role. Work will be assigned based on active client credentialing needs. Hours will vary depending on project volume, number of providers, and payer requirements.



Compensation

Compensation may be structured on a per-provider, per-payer, or per-project basis depending on the scope of work. Payment terms will be tied to clearly defined project milestones.



Payment Structure

 - 50% once the application package is complete and submitted correctly

 - 50% once the payer approves the provider or enrollment becomes effective

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Senior Data Engineer (Data Engineering, Data Warehousing & Analytics)

Position Summary



The IT Data Engineer is responsible for designing, building, maintaining, and modernizing the organization's data platform and reporting ecosystem. This role serves as the primary technical owner of data engineering initiatives, working closely with executive leadership, business stakeholders, and development teams to transform operational and third-party data into trusted, actionable business insights.



The position combines data engineering, data warehousing, reporting, and business partnership responsibilities. The successful candidate will help drive the organization's transition toward a modern, data-driven culture while supporting both current and future analytics initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

• Design, develop, and maintain data pipelines integrating internal and external data sources.

• Build scalable ETL/ELT processes and data quality controls.

• Maintain and enhance dimensional models, fact tables, and dimension tables.

• Create mapping tables and conformed dimensions for cross-system reporting.

• Develop and support Power BI dashboards, reports, and datasets.

• Partner with business stakeholders to gather requirements and deliver analytics solutions.

• Support migration from SQL Server-based warehousing to cloud-based platforms.

• Monitor and optimize reporting, query, and warehouse performance.

• Serve as a trusted advisor on data strategy and analytics initiatives.



Initial Priorities (First 6–12 Months)

• Learn business operations, products, inventory, and distribution processes.

• Integrate new third-party datasets into the data warehouse.

• Expand Power BI reporting and analytics capabilities.

• Improve data quality and standardization across systems.

• Develop a roadmap for cloud-based modernization and future data architecture.

Technical Environment

Current: SQL Server, Power BI, Star Schema Modeling, ETL Processes, Operational Systems.



Future: Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Lake, Cloud Data Platforms, Modern Data Warehousing Architectures, Advanced Analytics Solutions.

Success Measures

• Strong understanding of business operations and stakeholder needs.

• Successful integration of new data sources.

• Increased reporting adoption and business value.

• Improved data quality and trust in reporting.

• Progress toward modernization and cloud adoption.

• Establishment of scalable data engineering practices.

   (Databricks is a plus)



Overall Mission

Build and evolve the organization's data platform, integrate new data sources, improve analytics and reporting capabilities, and help transform the company into a data-driven organization through modern data engineering and business intelligence solutions.

- No guessing

- No interpretation

GOOD



Value:

21



BAD
